scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of the sharp finite-pulse global upper bound and all equality cases; exact-rational executable tests are limited consistency checks, not proofs or independent audits.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic autonomous scalar discharge recession; indivisible additive instantaneous increments, each greater than the fixed exceedance threshold; no finite planning horizon, rainfall routing, stochasticity, empirical calibration or nonlinear rainfall-to-discharge conversion. Priority provisional pending independent broader impulse-control literature review.
title: Threshold-chasing maximizes flood-exceedance duration under increasing recession laws
